body:
Native declared test credit (EO, w-24a7 route) requires the declared command to be the FIRST tool activity of a fresh turn. A mailbox read, an MCP call or any other tool call before it makes the run ineligible (docs/features/execution-observability.md).

So never send a RUN GO as a mailbox body that the agent must read first.
- Brief the agent in advance (prep message): when a wake shows a specific topic, run the exact declared command as the first tool call, and read the mailbox afterwards.
- Then send the trigger with `"$TERMAL_CLI" mailbox send ... --topic "C1-RUN-FIRST <id>"`. The topic appears in the wake prompt itself.

Learned 2026-11-07, from the Questly Linux run 1 on w-e072. It passed 1820/0 but was ineligible.
